top_signals.title: Stocks Set for Worst Day Since July as Bonds Rally: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A selloff in technology giants and escalating Middle East hostilities drove stocks toward their worst session since July, pushing global investors toward the safety of bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
top_signals.summary: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting off foreign crypto deals
top_signals.summary: "We're suing to stop the corruption and to force President Trump to return the profits to American taxpayers," attorney Matt Pelikan told CNBC.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
